observations.why: Directive with operational cadence language ('from now on') performs a settled, load-bearing commitment — the speaker expects others to act on it.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic, identity-level formulation stating a constitutive rule — rehearsed-or-it-doesn't-exist is presented as bedrock, not a movable claim.
Declarative recording of settled decisions with ratification language — the document performs the settling by listing them as decided.
